text: [excited] Yo. What if Mister White... never got cancer? Like, ever? Albuquerque, 2008. Dude gets his lungs checked, and the scan comes back... [whispers] clean. Clean, yo! No tumor. No clock ticking. So Walt just goes home, like a total square. He never rides along with Hank. He never finds me. Me, bitch! So no RV. No desert. No blue. Nothing, yo. And no pizza on the freakin' roof. Instead, he teaches chemistry. For twenty-five more years, man! He retires, all quiet and boring as shit. Nobody ever knew his name. Then Skyler's digging around the garage, and she finds this box. Inside? His formula, yo. Ninety-nine point one percent pure. Never cooked a single batch. [serious] Because cancer didn't make Heisenberg, man... It just gave him permission. [laughs] Science, bitch.
